name: MonarchSwitchRow
title: Switch
summary: The Monarch switch: the Material 52 by 32dp track in Monarch colours inside a 48dp touch target, with an optional label at the start. MonarchSwitchRow is the labelled row.
whenToUse: For a setting that takes effect immediately.
whenNotToUse: For a choice that is submitted with a form use a checkbox.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSwitch(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
@Composable fun MonarchSwitchRow(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, description: String? = null)

options.name: onCheckedChange
options.description: Called with the new value; null draws the switch only.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, at the start; the whole row toggles.

options.name: enabled
options.description: A disabled control is drawn at half opacity and ignores input.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press and focus interactions.

states.name: on
states.description: The control is filled with the strong accent.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled control and the disabled text color; announced as disabled.

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring around the row.

appearance: The track of a switch that is on is filled with the strong accent in every theme; off it is the muted surface with the input border.
platformNotes: Replaces the Material 3 Switch with the same 52 by 32dp geometry (16dp thumb off, 24dp on, 28dp pressed) and Monarch colours: on is the accent track with a white thumb in every theme, as on iOS; off is the muted track with the input border and a subtle thumb. Role.Switch, TalkBack says on or off. Migrating: Switch(checked, onCheckedChange) becomes MonarchSwitch(checked, onCheckedChange); drop colors and thumbContent.
accessibility: The row is one TalkBack element with the switch role, the label and the on or off state.
The whole row is the touch target and is at least 48dp high.
A disabled row is announced as disabled.
The switch is at the end and follows the layout direction.
The bare Switch needs a name: Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = ... }.
edgeCases: A long label wraps and the switch stays centered vertically.

examples.title: Settings row
examples.setupTemplate:
var first by remember { mutableStateOf({{items.0.checked}}) }
var second by remember { mutableStateOf({{items.1.checked}}) }
examples.setup:
var first by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
var second by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

examples.title: A switch without a visible label
examples.code:
MonarchSwitch(
    checked = dark,
    onCheckedChange = { dark = it },
    modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = "Dark theme" },
)

parityExceptions.reason: MonarchSwitchRow has no size parameter, so the small switch (size sm) of the second row is drawn at the standard size.
parityExceptions.convention: Material 3 and the system switch have one size; the platform switch is not scaled down
